import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 100010;
    static final int mod = 1000000007;
    static int n, m, tt = 0;
    static int[][] ch = new int[N][64];
    static int[][] p = new int[10][10];
    static int[][] q = new int[10][64];
    static long[][] f = new long[10][N];
    static Map<Long, Integer> id = new HashMap<>();
    static int maxState;

    static int qpow(int a, int b) {
        long ret = 1;
        long base = a;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                ret = (ret * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) ret;
    }

    static int dfs(long s) {
        if (id.containsKey(s))
            return id.get(s);
        id.put(s, ++tt);
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << n); i++) {
            long t = s;
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1 && ((i >> k) & 1) == 1 && ((s >> (j ^ (1 << k))) & 1) == 1) {
                        t |= 1L << j;
                    }
                }
            }
            ch[id.get(s)][i] = dfs(t);
        }
        return id.get(s);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        dfs(1L);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                p[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
                p[i][j] = (int) ((long) p[i][j] * qpow(100, mod - 2) % mod);
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << n); j++) {
                q[i][j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < n; k++) {
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        q[i][j] = (int) ((long) q[i][j] * p[k][i] % mod);
                    } else {
                        q[i][j] = (int) ((long) q[i][j] * (mod + 1 - p[k][i]) % mod);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        f[0][1] = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= tt; j++) {
                for (int k = 0; k < (1 << n); k++) {
                    int toState = ch[j][k];
                    f[i + 1][toState] = (f[i + 1][toState] + (long) f[i][j] * q[i][k]) % mod;
                }
            }
        }
        long fullMask = (1L << (1 << n)) - 1;
        int targetId;
        if (n < 6) {
            targetId = id.get(fullMask);
        } else {
            targetId = id.get(18446744073709551615L);
        }
        System.out.println(f[n][targetId]);
    }
}
